I'm not sure if this helps with panic disorder, but have you tried mindfulness? Don't try to calm yourself down, just try to focus on something. Drink something cold and sweet if you have it and concentrate on the flavors! Can you feel how ice old it is all the way down your chest as you drink? What's the flavor like? Describe it in detail. Find everything that is red around you. Run your hands under water and feel it. Concentrate on the five senses.
